description: Nadea wears an opaque deep purple floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and shaped elbow-length sleeves. Cream linen shows around the upper sleeves and in the narrow lower-front underdress panel. Rich gold scrolling woven borders trace the neckline, bodice seams, cuffs, waist and long skirt opening and hem. A cream wrap with ornate purple and gold borders rests around her forearms. Small jeweled circular clasps fasten the sleeve details and the decorated waistband. A modest purple-stone pendant, small earrings and rings provide restrained noble jewelry. One gold-purple embroidered flat shoe appears beneath the hem. Her short wavy hair is uncovered.
